prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Conroe, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1170; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the rear-end collision in Conroe, Texas. Please state your full understanding of what happened.

A: I was stopped at a red light on the main road heading north. Traffic was backed up a little, so I had come to a complete stop and had my foot on the brake.

Q: Where were you positioned in the lane when you stopped?

A: Right behind a white sedan in the right lane. I left a normal gap, maybe a car length.

Q: What happened next?

A: I felt a hard jolt from behind. My head snapped forward and then back against the headrest. The car behind me hit me going, I'd guess, faster than traffic was moving.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Only in the mirror for a second. It looked like a dark pickup, and I didn't have time to react.

Q: Were you able to drive your car from the scene?

A: The rear bumper was damaged and the trunk wouldn't close right, so it had to be towed. I walked over to the curb while we waited for the police.

Q: Did you seek medical attention?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care that evening. My neck was stiff and sore, and my lower back ached and tightened up through the night. They diagnosed a neck and back strain and gave me muscle relaxers and a referral to a physical therapist.

Q: Are your symptoms getting better or worse?

A: A little better each week, but I still get stiffness when I sit for long periods, and I can't lift anything heavy without my back complaining.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add?

A: Only that I was stopped, I was not distracted, and I'm willing to provide my records and the repair estimate whenever you need them.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
